name: Empty-State Observatory
description: Empty-State Observatory is a browser-based, software-only guessing game and reproducible synthetic benchmark. A visitor watches two seeded evolutions of an abstract, initially empty 32-state ring, guesses which run received a hidden synthetic disturbance, then reveals, replays or exports it. The ring evolves by a stable explicit heat step on its graph Laplacian with seeded forcing and noise. An OES-32-inspired consistency monitor checks peak, antipodal and FOLD8 residuals against a time-aligned clean reference and is benchmarked against a scalar RMS baseline for false alarms, detection rate, delay and misses. Scope: all traces, disturbances, scores and benchmark results are SYNTHETIC. It is not a model of physical universe dynamics, cosmology, quantum coherence or hardware, and its thresholds are documented design parameters, not calibrated limits. Python 3.12 and Node.js, no runtime third-party dependencies. pytest and Node tests run in GitHub Actions. License: AGPL-3.0-only.
